children.text: is a digital making contest held in Japan for children from elementary to high school, where participants use Minecraft Education to create works based on themes and compete with entries from across Japan and overseas.
I competed with several friends in a competition that tested our Minecraft technical skills and problem-solving abilities; we were finalists and received the Impress "Kids and IT" Award.

children.text: As finalists, we were interviewed and received media coverage.
Participating in Minecraft Cup was a major turning point for me. In particular, it’s no exaggeration to say that the trigger for my 2024
came from this. Because of the pandemic I couldn’t leave home, and it started as a small opportunity to participate with friends 😆
As of 2025, as a "graduate" I’m helping out with the organizing body, the
. I help at events held around the Kanto area and sometimes show my face, so please try to find me.
